name: the-himalayan-ramble
title: The Himalayan Ramble
description: Destination search, contact details, and trip-enquiry tools for The Himalayan Ramble, a Shimla-based, government-approved Himalayan travel operator running customized trips since 2000.
instructions: Use these tools to find a Himalayan destination, get the operator's contact details, or build a prefilled trip-enquiry URL. The website also registers the same tools in the browser through WebMCP (document.modelContext, with navigator.modelContext as the legacy fallback) on page load.

tools.name: search_destinations
tools.title: Search destinations
tools.description: Search The Himalayan Ramble's seven regions and their destinations by name.

query.description: Region or place name, for example Spiti, Ladakh, or Shimla.

tools.name: get_contact_details
tools.title: Get contact details
tools.description: Return the operator's phone, WhatsApp, email, office address, hours, and approvals.

tools.name: build_trip_enquiry_url
tools.title: Build trip-enquiry URL
tools.description: Build a contact-page URL prefilled with a destination so the user can start a trip enquiry.

destination.description: Optional destination name to prefill, for example Spiti or Ladakh.
